course: IB Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches SL

topics.title: Straight lines
topics.summary: Gradient, intercepts, parallel and perpendicular lines, the three forms of the equation of a line, midpoint, distance and the perpendicular bisector.

topics.title: Quadratics
topics.summary: Three forms of a quadratic, vertex and axis of symmetry, the quadratic formula, the discriminant, quadratic inequalities and applications.

topics.title: Functions and transformations
topics.summary: Domain and range, composite and inverse functions, rational functions and asymptotes, transformations of graphs and solving equations with technology.

topics.title: Exponents and logarithms
topics.summary: Laws of exponents and logarithms, exponential and logarithmic functions and their graphs, the number e, change of base and exponential equations.

topics.title: Statistics: basic statistics and correlation
topics.summary: Sampling, data presentation, measures of central tendency and dispersion, outliers, box plots, cumulative frequency, correlation and regression lines.

topics.title: Calculus 1: basic differentiation
topics.summary: Limits and the derivative, increasing and decreasing functions, tangents and normals, second derivative, maximum, minimum and inflexion points, concavity.

topics.title: Geometry and trigonometry
topics.summary: Right-angled trigonometry, 3D solids, sine and cosine rules, radians, arcs and sectors, the unit circle, exact values, trigonometric equations, graphs and models.
